newsitem.title: USA: Duke seen readying 846 MW Oconee, S.C. nuke.
newsitem.headline: Duke seen readying 846 MW Oconee, S.C. nuke.

text.p: Duke Power Co was preparing to synchronize the 846 megawatt (MW) Oconee 3 nuclear power unit to the electricity grid early Friday following startup repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.

The unit was operating at 17 percent of capacity and the company was "preparing to place unit on line following resolution of problems with new integrated control system," the NRC said in its daily plant status report for Friday.
Oconee 3, in Seneca, S.C., was shut in October, 1996 for pipe inspections after a steam pipe burst at the adjoining Oconee unit 2.
Oconee units 1 and 2, each with a capacity of 846 MW, were operating normally at full capacity as of early Friday, the NRC said.
